name: Sanity
summary: Headless content platform with a dark-first editorial marketing surface — 112px display type, IBM Plex Mono technical eyebrows, and a single coral-red accent reserved for the highest-priority CTA.

colors.name: Sanity Black
colors.role: The primary canvas and dominant surface color. Not pure black but close enough to feel absolute. The foundation of the entire visual identity.

colors.name: Pure Black
colors.role: Used for maximum-contrast moments, deep overlays, and certain border accents.

colors.name: Sanity Red
colors.role: The primary CTA and brand accent -- a warm coral-red that serves as the main call-to-action color. Used for "Get Started" buttons and primary conversion points.

colors.name: Electric Blue
colors.role: The universal hover/active state color across the entire system. Buttons, links, and interactive elements all shift to this blue on hover. Also used as `--color-blue-700` for focus rings and active states.

colors.name: Light Blue
colors.role: Secondary blue variants used for accent backgrounds, badges, and dimmed blue surfaces.

colors.name: Neon Green
colors.role: A vivid, wide-gamut green used as `--color-fg-accent-green` for success states and premium feature highlights. Falls back to `#19d600` in sRGB.

colors.name: Near Black
colors.role: Default page background and primary surface.

colors.name: Dark Gray
colors.role: Elevated surface color for cards, secondary containers, input backgrounds, and subtle layering above the base canvas.

colors.name: Medium Dark
colors.role: Tertiary surface and border color for creating depth between dark layers.

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Used for inverted sections, light-on-dark text, and specific button surfaces.

colors.name: Light Gray
colors.role: Light surface for inverted/light sections and subtle background tints.

colors.name: White
colors.role: Primary text color on dark surfaces, maximum legibility.

colors.name: Silver
colors.role: Secondary text, body copy on dark surfaces, muted descriptions, and placeholder text.

colors.name: Medium Gray
colors.role: Tertiary text, metadata, timestamps, and de-emphasized content.

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Text on light/inverted surfaces.

colors.name: Near Black Text
colors.role: Primary text on white/light button surfaces.

colors.name: Error Red
colors.role: Destructive actions, validation errors, and critical warnings -- a pure, high-saturation red.

colors.name: GPC Green
colors.role: Privacy/compliance indicator green.

colors.name: Focus Ring Blue
colors.role: Focus ring color for accessibility, matching the interactive blue.

colors.name: Dark Border
colors.role: Primary border on dark containers -- barely visible, maintaining minimal containment.

colors.name: Subtle Border
colors.role: Standard border for inputs, textareas, and card edges on dark surfaces.

colors.name: Medium Border
colors.role: More visible borders for emphasized containment and dividers.

colors.name: Light Border
colors.role: Border on inverted/light elements or buttons needing contrast separation.
